Subject: POC Kickstart Coordination — Aurora Health kickoff windows & success criteria

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to get the Aurora Health POC moving. To make the kickoff effective for all groups (AE + SE + Customer Eng + Procurement + Security), I want to propose a few 60-minute windows the week of Jan 16 where we can align on scope, timeline and success criteria. Please confirm which works for your team or propose alternates.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jan 16 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jan 17 — 13:00–14:00
- Thu Jan 18 — 09:00–10:00

Suggested kickoff agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions & goals (10) — AE (Vanessa)
2) Technical overview & network/infra asks (20) — SE (Karthik)
3) Success criteria & evaluation plan (15) — Customer + Redwood
4) Procurement & next steps (10) — Procurement rep
5) Q/A & action items (5)

Please include your procurement and security contacts on the thread so we can cover contractual and evidence requirements up front. I'm attaching a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft success-criteria doc to speed alignment.

Attachments: Aurora_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx, POC_Success_Criteria.docx

Thanks — I can also flip to different times if you need a morning/evening alternative for APAC folks.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

That makes Wed 13:00–14:00 the only slot that looks realistic for cross-functional attendance.
